name: Minecraft
whisper_prompt: Minecraft, Mojang, throwing disc, off-hand, Bedrock Edition, Java Edition, netherite, diamond, copper, iron, gold, trident, Loyalty, creeper, skeleton, zombie, game drop, TwitchCon.
notes: Mojang usage guidelines: you may use Minecraft name, footage and screenshots in videos, but never imply the video is official, approved by or connected to Mojang/Microsoft; no Mojang logo as our branding; nothing harmful or deceptive. Official reveal footage = YouTube channel 'Minecraft' only, muted. Never present fan-site 'recipes' or datamines as official. Audience is young: zero gore, zero swearing.
known_facts: Throwing Disc revealed by Mojang at TwitchCon San Diego, Nov 14 2026 (official video 5um9-i2Ta7w). Coming in the first game drop of 2027, no exact date. Official: throw it, it passes through enemies hurting them, then comes back to you; medium range by design; ricocheting off surfaces extends its flight (trick shots); craftable from copper, iron, gold, diamond and netherite; throwable from main hand or off-hand; balanced against existing weapons. Full off-hand support comes to Bedrock (next preview). NOT official yet: exact crafting recipe/grid, damage numbers, cooldown, range in blocks. Not in any snapshot as of Nov 19 2026.
